title: Kling - V2.5 Turbo Image to Video Pro

input.title: Kling - V2.5 Turbo Image to Video Pro — input
input.description: Input parameters for the generation task

prompt.description: The text prompt describing the video to generate (Max length: 2500 characters)
examples: A team of paratroopers descends into enemy territory, as they pass through clouds, the camera switches to a slow pan above the battlefield lighting up with

image_url.description: URL of the image to be used for the video (File URL after upload, not file content; Accepted types: image/jpeg, image/png; Max size: 10.0MB)

tail_image_url.description: Tail frame image of video (File URL after upload, not file content; Accepted types: image/jpeg, image/png; Max size: 10.0MB)

duration.description: The duration of the generated video in seconds

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt to exclude certain elements from the video (Max length: 500 characters)

cfg_scale.description: The CFG (Classifier Free Guidance) scale is a measure of how close you want the model to stick to your prompt (Min: 0, Max: 1, Step: 0.1) (step: 0.1)
